query: 2025年每月的订单总金额，以及相比上月的增长率

outcome.sql:
WITH "monthly_sales" AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', "o"."order_date") AS "month_start",
         SUM("o"."amount") AS "total_amount"
  FROM "public"."orders" "o"
  WHERE "o"."order_date" >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND "o"."order_date" < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', "o"."order_date")
)
SELECT TO_CHAR("ms"."month_start", 'YYYY-MM') AS "order_month",
       "ms"."total_amount" AS "total_amount",
       CASE
         WHEN LAG("ms"."total_amount") OVER (ORDER BY "ms"."month_start") IS NULL THEN NULL
         WHEN LAG("ms"."total_amount") OVER (ORDER BY "ms"."month_start") = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE ROUND(
           ("ms"."total_amount" - LAG("ms"."total_amount") OVER (ORDER BY "ms"."month_start"))
           / LAG("ms"."total_amount") OVER (ORDER BY "ms"."month_start") * 100, 2
         ) || '%'
       END AS "growth_rate"
FROM "monthly_sales" "ms"
ORDER BY "ms"."month_start" ASC
LIMIT 40
